Before release of this game the only shooter in Warhammer 40k universe I knew was Fire Warrior. And probably, it was the only one exiting back then. However, not much of people remember it today but many remember this game. Because of all the shooters set in Warhammer 40k universe, "Space Marine" is clearly one of the best if not the best one. Unlike old "Fire Warrior" it's a third person shooter and the first association that comes in mind here it's probably Gears Of War series but there is big difference between these titles. "Space Marine" is not cover based third person shooter. To survive you need to play more aggressive and if in multiplayer you at least have auto-regen function, in singeplayer campaign the only possibility to heal is to execute an enemy but first you need to stun one. This is a how action game set in Warhammer 40k universe shall be designed indeed. So, that being said, if you are into Warhammer, you can't pass by this game! Right now, when sequel is not released yet, this is the best way to immerse yourself into role of one of Adeptus Astartes and slaughtering countless xenos and heretics in the name of the Emperor! And I think even when sequel will be released it will be still cool to play this first game if you do like this setting and to touch the history. So, it offers a solid singleplayer campaign and also multiplayer with pvp and pve modes. And at the moment of when this review is being written there are still some active players. Which is maybe surprising for such old game but still. So, yeah, I absolutely recommend "Space Marine".  The way how all these iconic weapons sound, be it heavy bolter or plasma rifle, how all characters speak and look, it made me really to be immersed into Warhammer 40k!
